reason: Plates come from one cow's glycerol-stored rumen sample, serially diluted 10-1 to 10-6 and plated in duplicate on M10 with or without clarified rumen fluid. ENA labels that sample ("Rumen inoculum source Dilution factor 0"), its six dilutions and the 24 plates, matching the paper ("24 plate samples, 7 rumen samples from the cultivation experiment"), so the plates link to their source (D-028, which corrects the D-019 amendment). The 37 "Bovine rumen sample" libraries are other cows and are not used. The paper names 515F/806R (V4) but prints the 341F and 907R sequences; the deposited reads are one merged file per run, 252-254 bp, starting at the base after 515F, so the data are the V4 window.

Clean design (leaf-wash community vs five media), but 454 pyrosequencing: homopolymer errors and a separate denoising path for 24 runs (4 environmental). Excluded by D-017; revisit only if it fills a habitat gap nothing else covers.
The original culture-enriched molecular profiling study, but no raw reads are public: the BioProject exists at NCBI yet links to zero SRA runs, and ENA returns no runs.
